places.name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
places.ai_summary: Coastal national park at the 'End of the World'. Features subantarctic forests, marine wildlife, hiking trails (coastal path, Cerro Guanaco), Lapataia Bay (end of Pan-American Highway), and the scenic End of the World Train.

opening_hours.notes: Check official park website for current hours and fees

places.place_tip: Located west of Ushuaia. Can be reached by car, taxi, shuttle, or the End of the World Train (to park entrance). Bring layers for changeable weather. Check trail conditions.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for park entry; required for train/some tours
places.address: Parque Nacional Tierra del Fuego, Tierra del Fuego Province, Argentina

places.name: End of the World Train (Tren del Fin del Mundo)
places.ai_summary: Tourist steam train that runs along the final 7km of the old convict train line into Tierra del Fuego National Park. Offers a scenic ride through the Pipo River valley with historical narration.

opening_hours.notes: Check official website for current timetable and booking

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance, especially in peak season. Departs from the 'End of the World Station' outside Ushuaia. Offers different classes of service. Drops passengers at the National Park entrance.
places.address: Estación del Fin del Mundo, RN3 km 3042, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Beagle Channel Cruise
places.ai_summary: Boat tours departing from Ushuaia navigate the historic Beagle Channel, offering views of the city against the mountain backdrop, wildlife sightings (sea lions, cormorants, potentially penguins on Martillo Island tours), and landmarks like Les Eclaireurs Lighthouse.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedules with tour operators (e.g., Catamaranes Canoero, Tolkeyen, PiraTour)

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (penguin season approx Oct-Apr for Martillo Island)
places.place_tip: Book in advance, especially for penguin tours. Bring warm, windproof, and waterproof layers. Different tours visit different islands/landmarks.
places.address: Departs from Ushuaia Tourist Port, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Martial Glacier Hike
places.ai_summary: Small cirque glacier located in the mountains directly behind Ushuaia. Accessible via a chairlift (check operational status) partway up, followed by hiking trails leading towards the glacier base offering city and Beagle Channel views.

opening_hours.Monday: Trail accessible (weather permitting); Chairlift seasonal/variable hours
opening_hours.notes: Chairlift operation is often intermittent, check locally. Hike possible without chairlift.

places.place_tip: Trail can be steep and rocky towards the top. Wear sturdy hiking shoes and layers. Check chairlift status beforehand if planning to use it. Offers great views back over Ushuaia.
places.advanced_booking: Not required (chairlift tickets on site if operating)
places.address: Base del Glaciar Martial, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Museo Marítimo y del Presidio
places.ai_summary: Located in Ushuaia's former prison building. Combines four museums: the Maritime Museum (regional exploration/shipwrecks), the Prison Museum (history of the penal colony), the Antarctic Museum, and a Marine Art Museum. Offers a fascinating look at Ushuaia's history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary seasonally, check website

places.place_tip: Allow ample time as there's a lot to see across the different wings. The prison section is particularly atmospheric.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, tickets at entrance
places.address: Yaganes y Gobernador Paz, V9410 Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Les Eclaireurs Lighthouse
places.ai_summary: Iconic red-and-white striped lighthouse located on a small islet in the Beagle Channel near Ushuaia. Often mistakenly called the 'Lighthouse at the End of the World'. A key sight on Beagle Channel boat tours.

opening_hours.notes: Cannot disembark, viewed from water

places.place_tip: Included on most standard Beagle Channel boat tours. Good photo opportunity with wildlife often nearby.
places.address: Les Eclaireurs Islets, Beagle Channel, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Laguna Esmeralda Hike
places.ai_summary: Popular day hike near Ushuaia leading through forest and peat bog to Laguna Esmeralda, a stunning glacial lake known for its vibrant emerald color, located at the base of the Albino Glacier and surrounding peaks.

opening_hours.notes: Check conditions, can be very muddy

places.place_tip: Trailhead located off RN3, approx 20 mins drive from Ushuaia. Wear waterproof hiking boots as the trail can be extremely muddy, especially through the peat bog. Bring layers.
places.address: Trailhead on RN3 (approx Km 3060), near Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Museo del Fin del Mundo
places.ai_summary: Museum focusing on the regional history of Tierra del Fuego, including indigenous peoples (Yámana, Selk'nam), maritime history, natural history, and the early penal colony. Housed in several historic buildings in Ushuaia.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, especially off-season; confirm locally

places.place_tip: Provides a good overview of the region's diverse history. The figurehead collection is notable.
places.address: Av. Maipú 173, V9410 Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Isla de los Lobos (Sea Lion Island)
places.ai_summary: Small island in the Beagle Channel, a common stop on boat tours. Home to a large colony of South American sea lions ('lobos marinos'). Offers close-up views of the animals from the boat.

opening_hours.notes: Cannot disembark, viewed from water

places.place_tip: Included on most standard Beagle Channel boat tours. Boats usually get quite close for good photo opportunities.
places.address: Isla de los Lobos, Beagle Channel, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Bahía Lapataia
places.ai_summary: Picturesque bay located within Tierra del Fuego National Park, marking the southern end of Argentina's National Route 3 and the conceptual end of the Pan-American Highway system. Offers boardwalks, viewpoints, and short trails.

opening_hours.notes: Check park hours

places.place_tip: Popular photo spot with the 'End of Route 3' sign. Easy walks along the boardwalks provide nice coastal views. Can be reached by car/shuttle within the park.
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Bahía Lapataia, Tierra del Fuego National Park, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Glacier Martial Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Area at the base and slopes below Martial Glacier offering viewpoints looking back over Ushuaia city and the Beagle Channel. Accessible via road, potentially chairlift (check status), and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Check road/trail conditions; chairlift status/hours highly variable

places.best_time_to_visit: Summer (Dec-Mar) for hiking; clear days for views
places.place_tip: The viewpoint near the upper chairlift station (if accessible) provides excellent panoramas. Dress warmly as it's exposed and often windy.
places.address: Base del Glaciar Martial, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Hike to Laguna Turquesa
places.ai_summary: Challenging day hike near Ushuaia leading to a small, vividly turquoise glacial lagoon nestled in a high mountain cirque below Cerro Carbajal.

opening_hours.notes: Steep and demanding trail, check conditions

places.place_tip: Trailhead located off RN3 past Ushuaia. Strenuous uphill climb, requires good fitness and hiking experience. Wear proper hiking boots and layers. Can be combined with Laguna Esmeralda area.
places.address: Trailhead on RN3 (near Valle de Lobos), Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Avenida San Martín Shopping Street
places.ai_summary: The main commercial avenue in Ushuaia town center. Lined with shops selling outdoor gear, souvenirs, chocolates, clothing, as well as restaurants, cafes, tour agencies, and banks.

opening_hours.Sunday: Shop hours vary (many closed or reduced hours)
opening_hours.notes: Street accessible 24/7; check individual shop hours, many close for siesta

places.place_tip: Good place for souvenir shopping (look for 'Fin del Mundo' items), booking tours, or finding a meal. Can be busy with cruise ship passengers.
places.address: Av. San Martín, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Estancia Harberton
places.ai_summary: Historic estancia (ranch) located east of Ushuaia on the Beagle Channel. Founded by Anglican missionary Thomas Bridges. Offers tours of the historic buildings, shearing shed, gardens, and the Acatushún Museum of marine mammals and birds. Access point for some penguin tours (Isla Martillo).

opening_hours.notes: Requires booking/tour; check website for season dates and tour times

places.place_tip: Accessible by road (partially unpaved) or included in some boat tours. Book tours in advance. Offers insight into early European settlement and regional natural history.
places.address: Estancia Harberton, Ruta J km 45, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Yamana Museum
places.ai_summary: Museum dedicated to the culture and history of the Yámana (or Yaghan) indigenous people, the original inhabitants of the Tierra del Fuego coastal region. Features scale models, artifacts, and exhibits depicting their way of life.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, especially off-season; confirm locally

places.place_tip: Located centrally in Ushuaia. Provides valuable insight into the region's indigenous heritage.
places.address: Rivadavia 56, V9410 Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Canal Beagle Kayak Tour
places.ai_summary: Guided kayaking tours on the Beagle Channel offer a water-level perspective of the scenery, coastline, and potentially wildlife. Various tour lengths and routes are available.

opening_hours.notes: Weather dependent; check operator schedules

places.place_tip: Requires booking with a tour operator. Drysuits and equipment usually provided. Good way to experience the channel actively.
places.address: Various departure points near Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Cerro Castor Ski Resort
places.ai_summary: Southernmost full ski resort in the world, located about 26km from Ushuaia. Known for good snow quality and a long season (often June-October). Offers slopes for all levels, ski school, and equipment rental.

opening_hours.notes: Check official website for exact season dates and lift hours

places.place_tip: Requires transport from Ushuaia (shuttle, taxi, car). Book accommodation/passes/lessons in advance, especially in peak season (July/Aug).
places.address: Ruta Nacional 3, km 3019, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Laguna Negra Trail
places.ai_summary: Trail leading to Laguna Negra, a dark-water lagoon. Note: There are multiple 'Laguna Negra' hikes in Patagonia; the one near Ushuaia is often accessed via paths starting near the Valley of Wolves or RN3, potentially involving forest and some ascent.

opening_hours.notes: Trail specifics vary; check local trail info/maps

places.place_tip: Verify the exact trail location and difficulty near Ushuaia. Trails can be poorly marked or muddy. Bring appropriate gear.
places.address: Trailhead likely off RN3, near Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: End of the World Sign & Photo Point
places.ai_summary: Refers to various signs and viewpoints signifying Ushuaia's status as the southernmost city. Key locations include the sign at the Ushuaia tourist pier and the 'End of Route 3' sign within Tierra del Fuego National Park (Bahía Lapataia).

opening_hours.notes: Public signs/locations; park location requires park access

places.place_tip: Popular photo spots. The pier sign is easily accessible in town; the Route 3 sign requires entering the National Park.
places.advanced_booking: Not required (Park fee needed for NP location)
places.name_english: End Of The World Sign & Photo Point
places.cost: Free (pier); Paid (NP sign requires park fee)
places.address: Ushuaia Tourist Pier / Bahía Lapataia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina

places.name: Beagle Channel Sunset View
places.ai_summary: Various points along Ushuaia's waterfront or slightly elevated areas offer scenic sunset views over the Beagle Channel, with the surrounding mountains often catching the late light.

opening_hours.notes: Public viewpoints

places.place_tip: Walk along the waterfront promenade (Costanera) or find slightly elevated spots for good views. Sunset times vary significantly by season (very late in summer).
places.address: Waterfront / Costanera, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina
